headline: Amazon ties Qualcomm custom AI inference silicon and optical connectivity to a purchase-linked warrant
summary: Qualcomm and Amazon announced a multi-generation collaboration on customized silicon for AWS AI inference and optical connectivity extending to 1.6T. A same-day Qualcomm SEC filing gives the commercial structure unusual evidentiary weight: Amazon received a warrant for up to 25 million Qualcomm shares at $161.26, with vesting tied to commercial arrangements, binding purchase orders and actual purchases of Qualcomm server-chip products, technology, systems and manufacturing services, up to $60 billion in payments; 3.75 million shares vested at issuance based on initial purchase commitments. The $60 billion figure is a vesting ceiling, not a guaranteed purchase commitment.
